test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT the correct statement when fitting rings in an internal combustion (IC) engine?

options.text: This is vital for maintaining proper combustion pressure and preventing oil consumption issues.
Cleaning the piston head sealing surface area thoroughly is required.
Use of specialised tools to install the rings without twisting or damaging them is essential.
The most crucial precaution is to ensure proper ring gap and alignment by carefully checking the end gap of each ring.

solution:
The correct answer is __Cleaning the piston head sealing surface area thoroughly is required.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Proper combustion pressure__ is vital for engine performance and to prevent oil consumption issues.
 
• The use of specialised tools ensures rings are installed correctly without twisting or damage.
 
• Checking the end gap and alignment of each ring is crucial for proper functioning.
 
• Cleaning the piston head sealing surface is not a mandatory step in this specific process but is a good practice for general engine maintenance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ring Installation:**

 
 
• Avoid forcing or bending the rings during installation.
 
• Ensure proper lubrication to avoid damage during assembly.
 
 
 
• **End Gap Measurement:**
 
 
• Place the ring inside the cylinder and use a feeler gauge to measure the gap.
 
• Ensure the gap meets manufacturer specifications to prevent issues like blow-by.
